title: The Sims 2: Double Deluxe (PC, 2008) - Disc Only
descriptionText: The Sims 2: Double Deluxe for PC, released in 2008, offers a comprehensive role-playing experience within the popular Sims series. Published by Electronic Arts, this game provides players with the opportunity to create and manage their own virtual characters, navigating through various romantic, career, and social scenarios. With a T-Teen rating, this NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) version of the game delivers hours of entertainment for fans of the simulation genre.
